name: Kyle Marketplace
summary: Kyle Marketplace is a 260,194 square foot community shopping center located in Kyle, Texas, one of the fastest-growing cities in the Austin-Round Rock metro area. Managed by InvenTrust Properties, this open-air retail destination serves the everyday shopping needs of the rapidly expanding suburban community.
demographics: Kyle Marketplace serves a rapidly growing suburban family demographic in one of the fastest-growing cities in Texas. The primary trade area consists of young families with median household incomes in the $70,000-$90,000 range, attracted to Kyle's affordable housing and proximity to Austin. The center draws heavily from households with children, dual-income families, and first-time homebuyers seeking convenient access to everyday shopping needs. The customer base skews toward value-conscious shoppers who prioritize convenience and one-stop shopping for groceries, services, and family dining options.
description: Kyle Marketplace is a 260,194 square foot community shopping center strategically located at 5401 FM 1626 in Kyle, Texas, serving the rapidly expanding Austin-Round Rock metropolitan area. Situated in Hays County, this open-air retail destination has become an essential hub for one of Texas's fastest-growing communities, providing convenient access to everyday shopping, dining, and services. The center is professionally managed by InvenTrust Properties, a leading retail real estate investment trust specializing in essential retail properties in high-growth markets. With its smart location along a major thoroughfare, Kyle Marketplace captures both local residents and pass-by traffic from the greater Austin area. The property features a well-planned site design with ample parking and easy accessibility, making it a preferred shopping destination for families and professionals in the Kyle community.
